Title: Successfully add a new weekend day for a shop
Preconditions: A shop with ID 100 exists in the system
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/shops/100/weekends with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response status and body.

Test Data: {"dayOfWeek": "SATURDAY"}
Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response body contains the newly created weekend details, including 'shopId' as 100 and 'dayOfWeek' as 'SATURDAY'.

Title: Successfully retrieve all weekend days for a shop
Preconditions: A shop with ID 100 exists in the system and has at least one weekend day configured (e.g., SATURDAY)
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/shops/100/weekends. 2. Verify the response status and body.
Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response body contains a list of weekend days for the shop, including 'shopId' as 100 and 'dayOfWeek' values (e.g., 'SATURDAY').

Title: Successfully update an existing weekend day for a shop to a new day (future dates only)
Preconditions: A shop with ID 100 exists in the system and has a weekend day configured (e.g., SATURDAY). The current day is not SATURDAY.
Steps:
1. Send a PUT request to /api/shops/100/weekends with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response status and body.

Test Data: {"oldDay": "SATURDAY", "newDay": "SUNDAY"}
Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response body contains the updated weekend details, including 'shopId' as 100 and 'dayOfWeek' as 'SUNDAY'.
